answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tie each key to a 40-credit basalt bond and slash linked keys together. At every epoch's nadir, when real traffic is lowest, five random established auditors compare keys' request timing and funding paths. Keys found to form one cluster enter violet probation: each loses 10% of its bond times the cluster size, so 2 linked fakes lose 8 credits each and 10 lose all 40. A lone honest key risks 4 credits at most. Weakness: farms can add timing noise, so shared funding carries most weight.
